comparison.objective: Replace a toilet roll and refit its spring spindle; candidate transfers an uncaged linear-bearing block from rail to jig while preserving rolling elements.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require bimanual alignment, but the record compresses and steers a spring spindle into two sockets; the candidate must maintain a flush rail–jig support path during sliding and regrasping so free balls cannot escape.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires the new roll installed, both spindle ends seated, old tube removed, released and stable. Candidate requires complete transfer, continuous support, all balls retained, no jam/impact/contamination, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Socket seating of a spring-loaded spindle does not test continuous rolling-element containment. Shared bimanual alignment is generic.
